title: Manto partition stories (Selected Stories, Jalal-framed English edition)
tone_mechanism: Clinical reportage: atrocity reported in case-file cadence — inventory of bodies and goods, attributed speech, plain declaratives, dates and places stated without rhetorical emphasis. The narrator borrows the record-keeper's register (echoic mention of the official report) and never supplies moral reaction; the dissociation is carried entirely by the absurd horror of what is being catalogued.
